import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'aos7-llmdiag'

class TestLlmdiag(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_missing(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), tmp], capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0)
            obj = json.loads(p.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(obj['v'], 1)
            self.assertEqual(obj['llmcall_pending'], [])
            p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), tmp + '/absent'], capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 2)

    def test_real(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            node = Path(tmp)
            call = node / 'llmcall/b/c'
            call.mkdir(parents=True)
            (call/'request.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(request=dict(model='m'),holder='h',endpoint='fake')))
            p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), tmp], capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(p.stdout)['llmcall_pending'], [dict(budget='b',call_id='c',stage='request')])

# llmdiag 規則

唯讀，非資料夾退出 2；正常一行 JSON 退出 0。
三表按 (budget,call_id,stage)、job、budget 排序；壞 request／frame／ledger 略過，壞 raw 的 pending 仍列 stage raw。
